subject: Discovery → Eval handoff: schedule trial kickoff & prompt set review
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Bowers <tom.bowers@aureliahealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery → Eval handoff: schedule trial kickoff & prompt set review

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the 30-minute discovery earlier. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to get a short evaluation running next week: 

Recap (from discovery)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference as a drop-in backend for real-time triage & routing workflows in Aurelia’s patient intake pipeline.
- Primary success criteria you called out: 95% pass-rate on intent classification across the prompt set, median latency < 80ms p50 for 32-token responses, and reproducible prompt scoring for the red team set.
- Data security: you need SOC2 evidence and a short audit log sample for the VPC option.

Proposed next step: 60-minute evaluation kickoff (technical deep-dive + trial plan). Agenda suggestion below. Please pick a preferred time.

Agenda (60 mins)
- 10m: Introductions + roles (SE + Eng manager)
- 20m: Tech deep dive (integrations, throughput expectations, SDK samples)
- 15m: Trial plan & success criteria (prompts, datasets, monitoring)
- 10m: Logistics (access, timeframe, who owns what)
- 5m: Q/A and next actions

Availability windows (PT) — please pick one or propose alternatives:
- Tue Oct 19, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Tue Oct 19, 3:00–4:00pm PT
- Wed Oct 20, 9:00–10:00am PT

Attached: draft trial charter (trial-charter-v0.1.docx) and a short checklist of security artifacts we typically provide. If you already have a preferred prompt set, please share; otherwise we’ll bring an initial 50-example prompt pack for you to iterate on.

If those windows don’t work, we can broaden to next week. Once we lock a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and include our SE and Solutions Engineer on the call.

Best,

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
https://redwood.com

Attachment: trial-charter-v0.1.docx (summary doc)
Attachment: aurelia-soc2-ask.pdf (artifact checklist)
